problem_context.problem_statement: Verify the smallest BST traversal primitive: read and return the left child pointer of one valid non-null node.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Return exactly ptr_of (bst_left g root) while preserving ownership of the root left-child field.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Input is a valid non-null BST node root and the concrete left-field cell agrees with bst_left g root. Output equals that modeled left pointer and the field cell is unchanged.
spec_hint: Use bst_traverse_def.h and bst_lib_1. Specify the concrete store(&(root->left), ptr_of(bst_left g root)) directly; this one-step case must not depend on bst_new strategies, bst_insert_new_lib, or bst_delete_new_lib.
preferred_hidden_properties: Preserve the exact root->left field cell; keep the model graph g unchanged.
forbidden_patterns: Do not strengthen this one-step primitive to full tree_store or introduce a loop/recursive traversal.
reference_case_hints: Use only QCP_demos_LLM direct field-read/store examples and bst_lib_1; never inspect QCP_demos_human.

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

mathematical_postconditions_required: Function specs must state what result the function computes, not only bounds or shape facts.
Loop invariants must connect processed state to the final mathematical postcondition.
avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
